observations: A large solar panel assembly with multiple blue photovoltaic cells.
The panel is mounted on a white frame or support structure.
A watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' is visible across the center.
The image appears to be a stock or generic photo rather than a specific seller's photo.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are legible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No wattage rating is visible on the panel in photo 0.
The number of cells is not clearly countable from the photo.
Origin and condition cannot be confirmed from a single photo.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may be a generic or counterfeit unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or sticker on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be non-functional or have significant degradation.
risks.proof: A video showing the panel producing power under direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The battery mentioned is not included in the photo.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.
Video of the panel connected to a multimeter showing voltage output in sunlight.
Photo of the battery if it is included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
